notes: QA audit batch 4 fixes (v1.11.26, report §14): BUG-030 _read_json no longer conflates corrupt/large/empty bodies — invalid JSON → 400 «JSON نامعتبر», too large → 413, empty → 400 «بدنه خالی» (raised as _BadJsonBody and answered in handle(), the same pattern as the BUG-024 ProgrammeCorruptError path; a non-dict JSON body is also 400 «JSON نامعتبر» instead of crashing on .get); BUG-031 POST /api/backup/restore and /api/backup/now now run inside STATE_LOCK, and restore snapshots the current good file with create_backup(kind, force=True) before replacing it (a corrupt current file is still preserved as .corrupt-<ts> instead); BUG-032 POST /api/backup/resolve-conflict accepts kind 'programme' (path resolves to the programme file, not just state/testbook); BUG-033 dead imports removed after the server.py split (subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile; DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL, STATE_KEY_TYPES, resolve_data_dir; MODEL_RE; 20 unused names from the srv.update re-export block; VERSION_FILE in srv/update.py) — sanitize_state is kept as a live re-export (verify1117_driver uses server.sanitize_state) — plus an AST-based unused-import check added to tests/run_tests.py; BUG-034 the «days without activity» insight and the weekly report's idle-days row now count a day active when it has recorded real minutes (actualMinutes > 0), not only ticks/tests; BUG-035 the weekly verdict compares the first 3 days against the last 4 (slice(3,7)), so Tuesday is no longer silently dropped; BUG-036 the edit and add box forms ask for confirmation when end < start (a genuine overnight box is kept — the programme has 7, all starting 23:00–23:35 — but a typo like 16:00→14:00 no longer silently becomes a 22-hour box); BUG-037 «گسسته و آمار و احتمال» now maps to "Discrete Math, Statistics & Probability" instead of colliding with «گسسته و آمار" ("Discrete Math & Statistics"); BUG-038 useful time recorded while the timer is running is back-filled onto the just-created session at timerStopCurrent (box total − session totals, capped at the session's own seconds), so box and session useful totals can no longer diverge; BUG-039 after a successful Google DELETE (or 404) the uid_map/imap entries for the deleted box are always removed regardless of which map the event id came from, so the next push no longer re-DELETEs a dead event and inflates the «deleted» count. Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix is untouched.
